We invest with patience and conviction, supporting companies through complexity and critical inflection points, enabling them to scale globally. As an evergreen, fund terms do not dictate our timeline – we're in it for the long run. Our focus is Sweden, but our reach extends across the New Nordics where we participate in strong syndicates alongside local co-investors, backing exceptional companies wherever they're building in the region. Software We back founders who have gone deep into an industry and come back with something that changes it — vertical AI and enterprise software, built on genuine domain conviction.
